title: A Directly Modulated Laser Platform for High-Dimensional Quantum Key Distribution
summary: High-dimensional quantum key distribution (HD-QKD) offers a promising approach to enhance secret key rates beyond conventional binary-encoded QKD, addressing the growing demand for secure data transmission. However, the practical application of most HD-QKD systems has been hindered by their complexity, as they require the preparation and detection of quantum states in large Hilbert spaces. Here, we design and experimentally realize a directly modulated laser platform for HD-QKD. It operates at a repetition rate of 312.5 MHz, yielding a remarkably simple and scalable architecture.
